about_the_game:
DEMO

Why Try It?


This demo will give a glimpse of your tragic story. Charged with a committing a murder you don't remember you are finally home to reveal the truth.

Includes the beginning 30 minutes of gameplay, two puzzles in total.

About This Game

Step into the haunting world of "Insanity Within" with this demo, where the echoes of a tragic past linger in every corner. Begin your journey in a manor steeped in sorrow, where every shadow holds a secret and every silence screams of a past tragedy. Navigate through the first two rooms, each a testament to a life unraveled, and feel the weight of the air thick with dread.

Challenge your mind with intricate puzzles that not only test your logic but also reveal the depths of the manor’s secrets. As you delve deeper, uncover fragments of a heartbreaking story through hidden notes and artifacts, each piece adding to the tapestry of grief and mystery.

This demo offers a glimpse into a journey of guilt and discovery, where the cost of truth is steep. Are you prepared to face the darkness that lies within?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 (3.2 GHz, 4 cores) or AMD Ryzen 5 1400 (3.2 GHz, 4 cores)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 (4 GB VRAM) or AMD RX 570 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 (3.0 GHz, 8 cores) or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X (3.7 GHz, 6 cores)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 (6 GB VRAM) or AMD RX 6600 XT (8 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card

short_description: A psychological-horror puzzle game where after 16 years in prison for a murder you don't remember, you're back at your family's manor as schizophrenia distorts your reality. Manage, or harness, your mental hallucinations to uncover the truth. Will it vindicate you? Or confirm your darkest fears...
